versions.changelog:
yt-agent 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Supports YouTube video analysis via the yt-mem-ai CLI for summaries, highlights, Q&A, and presentations, using only URLs or video IDs.
- Handles automated daily digests of latest subscription uploads, cross-channel video reviews, and group video analysis with synthesis.
- Anchors all highlights using transcript-grounded semantic search for accurate timestamps.
- Caches transcripts and reuses previously generated summaries to avoid redundant processing.
- Processes videos in their original transcript language, with translation available on user request.
- Never accesses the data store directly; strictly uses the yt-mem-ai CLI for all operations.
